ideas.pitch: Real-time browser extension that detects cloned AI voices on WhatsApp Web and phone call audio streams using acoustic fingerprinting.
ideas.problem_statement: Fraud Shield: Fighting AI-Powered Scams - impersonation using AI-generated voices.
ideas.title: VeriVoice AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an extremely relevant scam vector in India (voice cloning grandparent/banker scams) and leverages automated evaluation for real-time accuracy scoring.

ideas.pitch: A Telegram and WhatsApp bot that instantly analyzes incoming video notes and profile pictures for deepfake artifacts and generative manipulation.
ideas.problem_statement: Fraud Shield: Fighting AI-Powered Scams - fraudsters impersonating trusted people using AI faces.
ideas.title: DeepfakeShield WhatsApp Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact theme of visual impersonation scams with a high-utility interface that judges can test live on their phones within seconds.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered transaction safety interceptor that reads UPI payment gateway request screens and flags high-risk mule accounts and fraudulent merchant handles.
ideas.problem_statement: Fraud Shield: Fighting AI-Powered Scams - scams in India where institutions and trusted entities are impersonated.
ideas.title: UPI-Guard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Indian financial ecosystem (UPI), making the impact instantly intuitive and urgent for local judges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid link and contact analyzer that maps out known phishing clusters, fake UPI handles, and deepfake distribution networks in a visual node graph.
ideas.problem_statement: Fraud Shield: Fighting AI-Powered Scams - protecting people from AI-powered scams and impersonation.
ideas.title: ScamTrace Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates graph intelligence patterns from winning AML projects, showcasing deeper technical complexity in a 3-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent SMS scanner and semantic firewall that catches sophisticated AI-crafted phishing text messages before users click malicious links.
ideas.problem_statement: Fraud Shield: Fighting AI-Powered Scams - protecting users from AI-generated text and phishing scams.
ideas.title: Aegis SMS & OTP Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the automated evaluation metrics by providing a clean, measurable accuracy score on a live test suite of Indian banking scam messages.
